acceptance_gates.G01_PARENT_CUSTODY: The complete 92-file SAM Language v0.5 executable set must match candidate code hash 726011b38d27a9b5403a7df66d8d4d5ac7c49960bc331d65f57c66de7a7ecaf0, and the v0.5 release record must remain unchanged.
acceptance_gates.G02_SINGLE_LANGUAGE_PATH: Core, QP, and SLC programs must use one parser, one checker, one evaluator, one type system, and one ordered registry-extension path. Source-text dispatch and a sidecar SLC evaluator are forbidden.
acceptance_gates.G03_PROFILE_ISOLATION: Every SLC state-changing operator must execute only in the slc-c1-formal profile. Normal and research profiles must reject the same calls with SLCFormalProfileRequired.
acceptance_gates.G04_REGISTER_CARDINALITY: Exactly 12 labeled lebit sites SLC_L0 through SLC_L11 and exactly 4096 computational-basis addresses must be available. Partition-slot and QP-coordinate labels must not be accepted as lebit sites.
acceptance_gates.G05_EXACT_STATE_INVARIANT: Every accepted state must have a unique reduced sparse-integer representation and satisfy sum(n_i^2) = 2^h exactly. Floating-point comparisons may not decide state equality, normalization, or a gate result.
acceptance_gates.G06_FROZEN_OPERATORS: SLC_BINARY_FLIP, SLC_PREPARE_REQUEST, and SLC_X1_RESPONSE must reproduce the frozen B, canonical real balanced request, and conditional target response exactly and without fitted coefficients.
acceptance_gates.G07_COMPLETE_PAIR_LIFT: All 132 ordered distinct control-target placements over all 4096 basis inputs must close in both forward and reverse formula lanes: 540672 forward, 540672 reverse, and 1081344 classicalized schedule cases.
acceptance_gates.G08_SIGN_GAUGES: All four surviving SLCX002 real request sign gauges must remain representable as diagnostics and close on all 132 placements, for 528 placement cases. The installed canonical operator remains the positive-first-row gauge.
acceptance_gates.G09_FOREST_AND_DECOMPOSITION: The 66 rooted-forest induction parent cases and all 31572 native decomposition site assignments must reproduce one GHZ block per connected component under parent-before-child construction.
acceptance_gates.G10_EXTRA_EDGE: All 204 frozen intracomponent extra-response cases must perform the exact peel operation and the second identical response must restore the prior state.
acceptance_gates.G11_CLASSICAL_LIMIT: The eight frozen predecessor classical rows and every basis-state response must recover the deterministic classical truth table exactly.
acceptance_gates.G12_STATE_HISTORY_SEPARATION: Equivalent star and chain preparations must produce the same state hash and different history hashes. State inspection may identify the connected-component partition but may not infer internal rooted-tree history from the terminal state.
acceptance_gates.G13_DETERMINISTIC_RECEIPTS: Repeated API and CLI execution of the same program must produce byte-identical canonical state payloads, state hashes, route receipts, and history hashes.
acceptance_gates.G14_TRANSACTION_AND_TAMPER: Rejected operations must be atomic. Mutation of a coefficient, exponent, predecessor hash, operator argument, or receipt must be detected before the state is accepted for a subsequent operation.
acceptance_gates.G15_REGRESSION_AND_PARITY: All 154 SAM Language v0.5 tests, the new focused SLC tests, CLI/API parity checks, and clean-wheel tests must pass without modifying the v0.5 parent.
acceptance_gates.G16_BOUNDARY_PRESERVATION: The candidate must reject publication, sampling, complex-phase, physical-connectivity, coupling-cost, and hardware claims while retaining formal exact simulation authority.

functional_example: let s2: SLCState12 = SLC_X1_RESPONSE(s1, SLC_L0, SLC_L1)

SLC_BINARY_FLIP.semantics: Current SLC B: flip the selected computational-basis bit. This is distinct from PREPARE_REQUEST.

SLC_INSPECT_STATE.semantics: Read-only exact structural inspection. It does not mutate state or append a state-transition receipt.

SLC_PREPARE_REQUEST.semantics: Apply the frozen canonical real balanced involution H = (1/sqrt(2))*[[1,1],[1,-1]] to the selected site.

SLC_X1_RESPONSE.semantics: For distinct control and target sites, map |c,t> to |c,t XOR c> and leave all spectator bits unchanged.

SLC_ZERO_REGISTER.semantics: Create the exact 12-site |0...0> state and deterministic genesis custody receipt.

types.SLCLebitSite: One of the twelve typed register positions, not a partition slot, QP p value, carrier label, or support value.
types.SLCState12: Immutable exact 12-lebit joint state plus append-only route custody.
types.SLCStateInspection: Immutable exact readout of amplitudes, invariants, hashes, support, and formal component diagnostics.

history_semantics.failed_operation_behavior: Return a typed error atomically; do not create an output state or append a successful transition receipt.
history_semantics.history_hash_rule: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for the complete deterministic receipt chain head.
history_semantics.star_chain_requirement: Different valid rooted-tree histories producing the same exact terminal vector have identical state hashes and different history hashes.

open_boundaries.complex_phase_semantics: OPEN; no complex coefficient or phase operator is installed.
open_boundaries.coupling_magnitude_and_cost: OPEN; legacy 64/64/128 ledger costs are not assigned to coherent formal operators.
open_boundaries.measurement_and_publication: OPEN under LCQC012; no sampling, collapse, Born-rule, or COMMIT-as-publication operator is installed.
open_boundaries.physical_connectivity: OPEN; formal control-target placement and inferred component structure do not install a physical edge graph.
open_boundaries.production_registry_status: CANDIDATE ONLY until the complete sealed acceptance campaign passes and a separate release decision is made.

question: Can the frozen SLCX002 real two-operation grammar and the SLCX003 complete 12-lebit formal lift be implemented directly in one updated SAM Language kernel as an exact, deterministic, tamper-evident SLC C1 simulator without promoting open physical semantics?

register_semantics.canonical_reduction: Remove zero coefficients. While h >= 2 and every nonzero n_i is divisible by 2, divide every n_i by 2 and replace h with h-2. Preserve global sign.
register_semantics.site_bit_order: SLC_L0 is integer-address bit 0 (least significant); SLC_L11 is bit 11.
register_semantics.state_hash_rule: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON over the reduced amplitude payload only.
register_semantics.zero_state: h=0 with coefficient +1 at basis address 0

topology_semantics.allowed_claim: For states constructed by the frozen rooted-forest schedule, exact terminal correlations identify the connected-component partition and reproduce one GHZ block per component.
topology_semantics.child_before_parent_scope: A legal X1_RESPONSE operation on a valid state; it is a negative control only when mislabeled as a completed parent-before-child forest construction.
topology_semantics.duplicate_response_scope: Legal and involutive; it may peel or restore a target and must not be silently deduplicated.
topology_semantics.forbidden_claim: Terminal state alone identifies star, chain, root choice, internal tree edges, or installed physical connectivity.
topology_semantics.prepare_twice_scope: Legal and involutive; no blanket duplicate-prepare ban.
topology_semantics.response_domain: Any exact valid SLCState12 with distinct control and target sites.
